sloka: अर्चिस्सहस्रविकचं रविमण्डलसप्रभम्।स मुष्टिं पातयामास कुम्भस्योरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७६.९० ।।
transliteration: arcissahasravikacaṁ ravimaṇḍalasaprabham।sa muṣṭiṁ pātayāmāsa kumbhasyorasi vīryavān ।। 6.76.90 ।।

translations.english: Then mighty Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, hit by the fist, clenched his fist adamantly.
